headline: Delphi World Money submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Delphi World Money Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Routine corporate governance filing completes the post-AGM compliance process. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review shareholder resolutions passed during the meeting. The filing has no direct impact on the broader market or share price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate impact on share value
